help.profiles.click: Click a card to apply it. Clicking the current profile applies pending changes; unchanged profiles are not reloaded.
help.profiles.menu: Right-click a card, click its ⋯ button, or press m / Shift+F10 on a focused card to open its action menu.
help.profiles.menuControls: Menu: arrows / j / k choose; Enter runs an action; Esc / Tab or an outside click closes without activating the page.
help.messages.toast: Up to two Toasts appear in the upper-right. Ctrl+N opens the full list and details. Visible success lasts 3 seconds; info lasts 4 seconds.
help.messages.dismiss: Errors remain until closed. Cancel on a progress notice stops its task; closing the notice keeps it running. Esc returns one layer at a time.
